page.overview:
Who is Auernheimer?

Auernheimer was a Solkanite witch-taker during the time of the Black Death.

He rose to local prominence in Altdorf. Preaching to the frightened population. He believed that the disease was a punishment for the growing lack of religious fervor among the population. He even tried to arrest the Lord-Protector of the Empire, Adolf Kreyssig, for cavorting with witches (with the cooperation of Duke Vidor of the Empire), but the Lord-Protector was saved by the Skaven.

He was killed by the Grand Theogonist Gazulgrund in the temple of Sigmar in Altdorf.
